reason: Verification failed due to critical missing components (epidemiological dynamics, metrics/evaluation pipeline, mandate scope, rationing/price controls). With 3 iterations remaining, there is clear potential for significant improvement by restoring evaluation, adding a minimal infection model, aligning policies with scope, and computing required metrics. These changes are feasible within the remaining iterations and are necessary to meet the specification.

specific_areas: Reintroduce evaluation and finalize_metrics pipeline with a functional main() that runs the simulation and reports metrics.
Implement a minimal infection model (SIR/SEIR) with health_state, vaccination_status, infection, and recovery; integrate mask inward/outward efficacy and location transmission modifiers.
Compute epidemiological metrics: infection_attack_rate, effective_reproduction_number (Rt), and cases_averted (vs. a no-policy or baseline run).
Implement mandate_scope by location type and denial-of-entry logic tied to enforcement; compute compliance_by_location_type.
Extend Retailer/Government with rationing_limit_per_purchase and price controls (price caps/subsidies); integrate into purchase logic and pricing.
Track stockout days consistently (increment daily when any retailer is out) and summarize inventory_outage_days in finalize_metrics.
Enhance MediaChannel with reach, trustworthiness, and bias; broadcast to a sampled subset; track misinformation_prevalence time series/metric.
Throttle performance-heavy social influence/neighbor correlation (weekly or sampled) and guard with a diagnostics flag.
Compute equity metrics (equity_gap_in_adoption) across income deciles (and, if available, age and essential worker status).
Remove unused imports or gate optional plotting behind a config flag.

task_understanding.adjustments: Strictly align with the Mask Adoption Dynamics spec: add missing entities/attributes (health_state, vaccination_status, adoption_state, mask_type, mandate scope, location transmission modifiers). Ensure policy scope (indoor_public vs all_public) is respected across locations.

data_analysis.adjustments: Plan metric derivations end-to-end: adoption thresholds (time_to_50), peak/sustained adoption, compliance_by_location_type, equity gaps, inventory_outage_days, enforcement counts, misinformation_prevalence, cost_per_additional_adopter. For epi: compute attack rate, Rt (from infections or next-generation approximation), and cases averted vs baseline.

model_planning.adjustments: Design a minimal SIR/SEIR with daily time step: S→E (optional)→I→R transitions, importations, recoveries. Contact-based transmission at locations using contact_rate, location transmission_modifier, and combined mask efficacy (inward/outward). Define mandate enforcement logic (deny entry or fines) and rationing/price control mechanisms. Establish update order: info→adoption→visits/transmission→recoveries→metrics.

code_generation.adjustments: Extend classes (Individual, Location, Retailer, Government, MediaChannel) per spec. Implement evaluate() and finalize_metrics(). Provide main() that runs the sim and prints/returns metrics. Add config flags for diagnostics and social influence frequency. Implement rationing in purchase logic and price control hooks. Ensure backward compatibility and clear defaults.

code_verification.adjustments: Add smoke tests/assertions: presence of epi states, infection transitions occur, mandates scoped by location types, rationing cap enforced, any_stockout increments, evaluate() returns required keys. Gate heavy diagnostics; verify no unused imports. Validate that series keys exist before metric computation.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Throttle O(E) operations: compute neighbor correlation weekly or on a sampled subset; sample social-sharing updates. Add a diagnostics flag to enable/disable expensive passes. Ensure reproducible RNG seeding and reasonable runtime at target N.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Produce all required metrics with clear definitions. Run or emulate a baseline scenario to estimate cases averted. Ensure metrics are robust (avoid None where required; provide placeholders only if epi explicitly disabled). Summarize compliance by location and equity across subgroups.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise change logs with code diffs for new methods and fields, list new config flags, and include quick-start instructions to run main() and interpret key outputs. Note performance impacts and how to toggle diagnostics.
